content.title: Fix pre-existing Phase 1-3 e2e test failures
content.description:
8 pre-existing e2e test failures in Phase 1-3 validation suites, discovered while completing Phase 4 (mppqswn3jl). These failures exist on the baseline (before any Phase 4 changes) and are NOT caused by Phase 4 work.

Failing tests (consistent across runs):
1. phase1: 'renders the agentrack header' — test expects getByRole('heading', {name: /agentrack/i}) but 'agentrack' is rendered as a Link, not a heading. The only h1 is the page title ('Issues').
2. phase2: 'navigates from list to detail page' — expects getByText('Back to issues') visible, but IssueDetailPage only shows this link in the error/not-found branch, not the main render.
3. phase2: 'navigates back from detail to list' — same 'Back to issues' issue.
4. phase2: 'displays issue title and ID' — related to detail page rendering.
5. phase2: 'inline edit title' — related to detail page rendering.
6. phase3: 'displays empty state when no comments' — comments section issue.
7. phase3: 'adds a comment via the form' — comments section issue.

Plus 1 flaky backend test (varies between runs due to shared-state ordering in the e2e worktree): either 'defaults status to idea' or 'search is case-insensitive'.

Root cause appears to be: the IssueDetailPage does not render a 'Back to issues' link in its main content (only in the error branch), and the Header renders 'agentrack' as a link not a heading. These are Phase 1-3 implementation gaps.

content.content:
Triaging this idea through the ideas loop.

Duplicate check: searched all issues across every status. Related work exists (E2E port isolation in mpr50trdgw, the blockages-filter bug in mpscu5l9rk) but nothing addresses these specific Phase 1-3 e2e failures or their root causes (IssueDetailPage missing a 'Back to issues' link in its main render branch; Header rendering 'agentrack' as a Link rather than a heading). Not a duplicate.

Routing: this is a purely technical idea — broken tests exposing implementation gaps in the webapp, with no product/prioritization tradeoff. The webapp team has no dedicated architect, so it routes to the cto (the org's technical leadership, who has owned webapp technical decisions).

Created a Review task for the cto and a sync tracker so I'm woken when the decision lands. Setting this idea to in-progress + assigned to me so the work loop does not re-wake me on it.

Review decision: ACCEPT (3-way split by root cause). Transforming this idea into an Epic grouping three deliverables:

== Deliverable A (bug): Fix IssueDetailPage UX gaps ==
Real implementation gaps in the detail page main render branch:
- Missing 'Back to issues' link (only in error branch — IssueDetailPage.tsx:60-61)
- Raw issue ID never shown in the DOM
- Inline title edit unimplemented (description has it, title doesn't)
Phases: Reproduce (webapp-validator) → Dev (webapp-developer) → Validate (webapp-validator). No release — frontend bug.
Priority: highest (A first so the baseline goes green).

== Deliverable B (chore): Align e2e assertions with actual UI ==
Test/impl spec drift — the implementation is fine, the tests over-specify:
- phase1 'renders the agentrack header': test expects a heading role, but a brand Link is a valid pattern (Header.tsx:65). Fix the test.
- phase3 'displays empty state' / 'adds a comment': copy mismatch (CommentsSection.tsx:206-207 says 'No comments yet' / 'Be the first to add a comment'; test asserts different copy). Fix the test.
Phases: Dev (webapp-validator) → Validate (webapp-developer). No release — frontend chore.

== Deliverable C (chore): Isolate flaky shared-state backend test ==
The flaky backend test ('defaults status to idea' or 'search is case-insensitive') is shared-state ordering in the e2e worktree, not a Phase 1-3 implementation bug. Separate test-isolation fix.
Phases: Dev (webapp-validator) → Validate (webapp-developer). No release — frontend chore.
Priority: lowest.

All three proceed independently (different files, no interference). An Epic sync tracker (blocked by all three deliverable sync trackers) will wake me when everything is verified.

Structure created — Epic with 3 deliverables, each with its own sync tracker. The work loop will now pick up the unblocked first tasks automatically.

Three first-phase tasks are unblocked and ready for the work loop. Stepping back.

Epic complete — all three deliverables verified and done.
- Deliverable A (mqe04tpyqc): IssueDetailPage back link, issue ID display, inline title edit — validated PASS.
- Deliverable B (mqe060d1lh): e2e assertions aligned with webapp UI (header landmark, comments copy) — 59/59 PASS.
- Deliverable C (mqe06v82ul): flaky shared-state backend test isolated — 30+ runs zero failures, no regressions.
Epic-level gate (mqe07n9gwr) confirmed all three sync trackers passed. Closing the Epic and all descendants.
